your using -L"C:\SDL2\SDL2-2.0.3\i686-w64-mingw32\bin" rather than -L"C:\SDL2\SDL2-2.0.3\i686-w64-mingw32\lib", meaning that you were trying to link against the .DLL files rather than the .a libraries.

edit: for future reference, if it says it cannot find -lwhatever, that means it cannot find libwhatever.a. the best place to look for a solution is going through where the linker would look (i.e. the paths you designate)
